ouroboros.contracts.v1.AdmitChangeIntent.description:
AdmitChangeIntentRequest admits one approved ChangeIntent under the
 authenticated session; body identity remains an untrusted cross-check.

caller.description: caller is untrusted payload identity to cross-check against authenticated context.

idempotencyKey.description: idempotency_key distinguishes exact retries from conflicts.

intent.description: intent is the approved change intent pinned to an exact Git base.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.AdmitChangeIntent.title: Admit Change Intent Request

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Approval.jsonsche.description: Approval records one authenticated, scope-limited human or policy decision.

approvalId.description: approval_id is an opaque approval identifier.

approver.description: approver is the authenticated authority that issued the decision.

expiresAt.description: expires_at limits reuse of the approval.

receipt.description: receipt records the authorization decision and policy version.

scopeDigest.description: scope_digest binds the approval to the exact reviewed scope.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Approval.jsonsche.title: Approval

ouroboros.contracts.v1.AuthenticatedPrin.description: AuthenticatedPrincipalRef is an identity assertion emitted by a trusted boundary.

principalId.description: principal_id is never accepted as caller identity from an untrusted body.

sessionId.description: session_id identifies the authenticated session when a session exists.

tenantId.description: tenant_id is the authenticated tenant context.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.AuthenticatedPrin.title: Authenticated Principal Ref

ouroboros.contracts.v1.CausalContext.jso.description: CausalContext binds messages to an ordered, fenced causal history.

causationId.description: causation_id names the immediate triggering event or command.

fence.description: fence prevents an expired lease holder from committing.

sequence.description: sequence is monotonically assigned by the canonical ledger.

traceId.description: trace_id identifies a separately authorized trace stream.

watermark.description: watermark records the complete source position observed by a projection.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.CausalContext.jso.title: Causal Context

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ChangeIntent.json.description: ChangeIntent requests a scoped, reviewable change but cannot mutate source itself.

approval.description: approval is required before implementation scheduling under policy.

intentId.description: intent_id is an opaque change-intent identity.

repositoryGitOid.description: repository_git_oid pins the exact source base.

requestedBy.description: requested_by identifies the authenticated human or authorized policy actor.

scopeDigest.description: scope_digest binds approved paths, behaviors, and constraints.

supportingEvidence.description: supporting_evidence anchors the requested change to authorized evidence.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ChangeIntent.json.title: Change Intent

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.description: Digest identifies immutable bytes using a named digest algorithm.

algorithm.description: algorithm identifies the canonical digest algorithm, for example sha256.

hex.description: hex is the lower-case encoded digest value.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.title: Digest

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceRef.jsons.description: EvidenceRef identifies evidence metadata and optionally one precise anchor.

anchorDigest.description: anchor_digest identifies an optional canonical anchor serialization.

evidenceId.description: evidence_id is an opaque evidence identity.

sourceRevisionId.description: source_revision_id identifies the immutable source revision.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceRef.jsons.title: Evidence Ref

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.description: Identifier is an opaque, stable identifier within a declared namespace.

namespace.description: namespace prevents an identifier string from crossing a domain boundary.

value.description: value is opaque to consumers and must be non-empty after boundary validation.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.title: Identifier

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Receipt.jsonschem.description: Receipt records the authoritative outcome of an admitted operation.

causal.description: causal binds the outcome to replayable ordering and fencing state.

configurationDigest.description: configuration_digest pins the effective configuration without secret plaintext.

evidence.description: evidence records immutable inputs and outputs supporting this outcome.

operationId.description: operation_id identifies the command, run, or effect being receipted.

reasonCode.description: reason_code is a non-sensitive stable reason, never an upstream error body.

receiptId.description: receipt_id is a globally unique opaque receipt identifier.

recordedAt.description: recorded_at is when the receipt became canonical.

status.description: status is a stable, machine-readable outcome.
status.title: Receipt Status

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Receipt.jsonschem.title: Receipt

ouroboros.contracts.v1.UntrustedFactoryC.description:
UntrustedFactoryCaller carries body identity only for authenticated-context
 checks; the authenticated gateway session remains the sole authority.

requestedPrincipal.description: requested_principal must match the authenticated peer principal and tenant.

requestedSession.description: requested_session must match the authenticated gateway session.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.UntrustedFactoryC.title: Untrusted Factory Caller
